book_title: The Woman Inside: From Outer Space to Inner Peace
author: Bobbi Waterman
book_description: The Woman From Outer Space to Inner Peace will take you on a journey of self-discovery. Throughout a 34-year career at NASA, launching rockets or leading teams, while literally traveling around the world, the book takes you on a journey of discovery and transformation. This is one woman's experience of transitioning from presenting as male to presenting as female. You will join me as I overcome societal expectations that are assigned at birth and learn to, understand the difference between sexual hardware and gender software. Finally, you will see how I discover the ultimate truth -- that you are never too old to live life as your authentic self. If you are interested in NASA or exploring distant lands or how one makes the decision to transition, then this book is for you. This is my story and my life. You will know me almost as well as I know myself. I hope you enjoy it. BobbiShow more
